name: Acetylglucosamine
description: Acetylglucosamine (CAS 7512-17-6 ), commonly abbreviated as GlcNAc, is an amino sugar derivative used as a functional ingredient across cosmetic, pharmaceutical, and nutritional applications. It supports skin hydration and hyaluronic acid synthesis. In skincare formulations, GlcNAc is incorporated into serums, moisturizers, and brightening products where it supports hyaluronic acid precursor activity and helps address uneven skin tone. It is a versatile additive for modern beauty products. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as a building block in research-grade and nutraceutical preparations targeting joint health and mucosal support. It plays a critical role in cellular signaling pathways relevant to formulation performance. In functional food and dietary supplement production, it is formulated into capsules and powders marketed for connective tissue and gut lining support. This makes it a staple for manufacturers focusing on holistic wellness. Cosmetic formulators also use it as a humectant in combination with peptide systems, where its moisture-binding capacity contributes to product stability and skin feel. It integrates seamlessly into various aqueous systems. Acetylglucosamine is supplied as a white crystalline powder. It is available in food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications, with pharmaceutical-grade material meeting USP or BP standards where required for compliance. Bulk quantities are typically offered alongside smaller packaging options suited to formulation development and QA sampling. This ensures that both large-scale production and laboratory testing needs are met efficiently. Our supply chain ensures consistent quality and purity for all industrial applications.
